open_points.subject: state of a re-registered ended identity
open_points.text: Registering the ended identity again answers a session with no project.
open_points.question: Must this test show an empty granted set, no active project, no pending request and access version 1, or does “no project” assert only one of those facts?
options: Show all new-session facts: empty granted set, no active project, no pending request and access version 1.
Show only an empty granted set and no active project, leaving the pending request to another rule and version 1 to A12.
Treat “no project” as only no active project.
open_points.default_guess: Show all new-session facts, with the access-version assertion also credited to A12.

open_points.subject: security-review reopening after changed decisions
open_points.text:
Performed again on 2026-11-24, after the witnesses of A01–A19 and A22 were
bound to Factory checks of their Required tests in place of the
[TEST_EVIDENCE] notes, and the owner restated A03 rule 3 (a correction
leaves the created instant; its revision and last-changed instant follow
A04). No outcome changed; A03 is named by no category.
open_points.question: After the changes to A02, A04, A08, A09, A10, A11 and A12, what are the renewed outcomes for every security-review category that names those decisions, as A21 rule 2 requires?
options: Record a renewed review of authorization, concurrency, injection_interpreted_input and authentication_credential_abuse, naming the affected decisions and outcomes.
State explicitly that Required-test-only changes do not count as a decision change for A21 rule 2.
Restore the prior detailed review passage if it remains accurate.
open_points.default_guess: Record the reopened categories and state their renewed outcomes, including the effect of the reduced invariant-test coverage.
